title: Six-domain shape
hints: Count leftover valence electrons on iodine.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: I has five bonded neighbors and one lone pair. Remove one octahedral vertex from the molecular position count to give a square pyramid.
statement:
What is the molecular geometry of $\ce{IF5}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Five bonded atoms alone overlook the lone pair.
This would have four bonded atoms and two lone pairs.
